desc: This painted brass bottle weighs 1 pound. When you use an action to remove the stopper, a cloud of thick smoke flows out of the bottle. At the end of your turn, the smoke disappears with a flash of harmless fire, and an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.LTomFUTBrkRi0Pj5]{Efreeti} appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.
The first time the bottle is opened, the GM rolls to determine what happens from the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.tables.RollTable.yZMFNfocj5qyVuOC]{Efreeti Bottle} table.
name: efreeti bottle
